Our Story

About Victory Hardware & Distributors

Building Kenya's future, one project at a time.

Kikuyu's Trusted Hardware Partner

Victory Hardware & Distributors has established itself as one of the premier hardware suppliers in the Kikuyu environs and greater Kiambu County. What started as a small local shop has grown into a comprehensive building materials hub, serving contractors, fundis, and homeowners with quality products and exceptional service.

Our commitment to quality, competitive pricing, and customer satisfaction has made us the go-to choice for construction projects ranging from residential homes to commercial developments. We understand the unique needs of the Kenyan construction industry and stock products that meet local standards and preferences.

Our Vision: To become Kenya's leading hardware distributor, expanding our reach from Kikuyu to every corner of the country, making quality building materials accessible to all Kenyans.

Leadership

Meet Our CEO

The visionary leader behind Victory Hardware & Distributors

Chief Executive Officer

Leading with Vision & Purpose

Founder & CEO, Victory Hardware & Distributors

As the driving force behind Victory Hardware & Distributors, our CEO has transformed a local hardware shop in Kikuyu into one of the most trusted building materials suppliers in the region. With a deep understanding of the Kenyan construction industry and an unwavering commitment to quality, she has built a business that prioritizes customer satisfaction above all else.

Her leadership philosophy centers on three core principles: providing genuine, high-quality products at fair prices; delivering exceptional customer service that treats every client like family; and continuously expanding access to quality building materials across Kenya. Under her guidance, Victory Hardware has grown from serving just the Kikuyu community to becoming a preferred supplier for contractors and homeowners throughout Kiambu County and beyond.

Our mission is simple — to empower every Kenyan builder, from the individual homeowner to the large-scale contractor, with access to quality materials and honest service. We're not just selling hardware; we're building partnerships that help construct Kenya's future.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about our products, ordering, and delivery.

Do you deliver construction sites within Kenya?

Yes, we deliver across Nairobi and to major towns countrywide including Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Eldoret, and Thika. Delivery fees vary based on distance and order size. WhatsApp us to confirm availability for your area.

Do you accept M-Pesa payments?

Absolutely. We accept M-Pesa (send to 0723331505), bank transfer, cash, and card payments. For large orders, we can discuss payment terms. Contact us for details.

Can I get bulk pricing for large orders?

Yes. We offer competitive bulk pricing for fundis, contractors, and large projects. Request a quotation through our website or WhatsApp, and we'll provide custom pricing in KSh based on your material requirements.

Is there a minimum order quantity?

There's no minimum order for in-store or yard pickups. For delivery, minimum orders may apply depending on your location. WhatsApp us to discuss your specific needs.

Can you help me calculate material quantities?

Yes! Our experienced staff can help you estimate quantities based on your project plans. Send us your drawings or describe your project via WhatsApp, and we'll help you determine what you need.

What are your operating hours?

We're open Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM, and Saturday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM (EAT). Sunday by appointment only. WhatsApp inquiries are monitored during business hours.
